correctness.rationale: For k>=5 the weighted Vandermonde difference quotient has 2-adic valuation at least k-floor(log2 k)>=3. For k<=4 the polynomial coefficients have valuation >=-2, hence for increments divisible by 32 their difference quotient reduces to their derivative modulo 8. The k=3,4 derivatives vanish modulo 8; the k=1,2 derivatives yield the exact cubic residue polynomial, which is 4 modulo 8 for b congruent 1 or 2 modulo 4. Exact recurrence finite cross-checks corroborate the formulas but are not the infinite proof.
